title: 第十三章 高级武徒第十四章 曾经你把全高中最靓的妞摆在我面前
content_zh:
一个上午，王腾除了捡捡别人训练掉落的属性，就是找人切磋比斗。
身法，拳法，剑法，刀法，但凡他会的，都找人比试了一番。
比斗狂魔这个称呼不知不觉在这群中级学员之间传开了，也不知道谁传出来的？
“最好不要让我知道是哪个王八蛋！”
王腾听到有人这么称呼自己时，整张脸都黑了。
敲尼玛！
什么仇什么怨，这么黑我！
“阿……阿嚏！”
胖子吴亮正在极星武馆的食堂里吃午饭，突然一个喷嚏忍不住打了出来。
嘴里的饭呛进鼻子里，饭粒粘着鼻涕流了出来。
他揉了揉鼻子，郁闷道：“莫名其妙打喷嚏，难道是谁在背后骂我？真是缺德！”
……
王腾看了下自己的属性面板，在二楼的收获确实很大，一个早上，他的各项属性几乎要接近高级武徒了。
【悟性】：35
【体质】：66
【力量】：621
【速度】：323
【战技】：基础拳法（大成），基础身法（大成），基础剑法（大成），基础刀法（小成）
高级武徒的门槛，体质要达到70，力量700kg，速度百米五秒。
只要下午再努努力，一只粉嫩嫩的高级武徒就新鲜出炉了！

而几项基础战技也都提升了一个档次，拳法，剑法，身法从小成变成了大成，刀法从熟练提升到了小成。
整个实力发生了翻天覆地的变化。
不过遗憾的是，今天并没有捡到其他的战技属性，似乎大多数人都是选择这几门战技作为主要修炼项目。
从训练大楼出来，王腾往武馆食堂走去。
他从张少洋几个学员那里听说，极星武馆是有食堂的。
并且只要有钱，什么都能吃到。
哪怕星兽食材，也是有的！
这些星兽食材都是由武馆的武者猎杀，然后卖给了武馆，兑换成积分或者现金。
所以武馆的星兽食材比外面要丰富的多。
很多稀有的星兽，外面连卖都没得卖。
而且武馆食堂还专门请了灵厨大师，来处理星兽食材。
灵厨是依附武者职业而衍生出来的副职业。
每一个灵厨大师都必须具备原力，想修炼原力，则必须是武者。
content_en:
One morning, Wang Teng not only picked up the attributes that others had lost through training, but also found others to compete with others.
Body skills, boxing skills, sword skills, knife skills, whatever he knew, he found someone to compete with.
The title "Battle Crazy Demon" spread unknowingly among this group of intermediate students. I don't know who spread the word?
"Better not let me know which bastard it is!"
When Wang Teng heard someone calling him that, his whole face turned dark.
Damn it!
What kind of hatred or resentment, you are so blaming me!
"Ah...ah sneeze!"
Fatty Wu Liang was having lunch in the cafeteria of Jixing Martial Arts School when he suddenly couldn't help but sneeze.
The rice in his mouth choked into his nose, and the rice particles stuck to his nose and flowed out.
He rubbed his nose and said depressedly: "I sneezed out of nowhere, who is scolding me behind my back? It's really wicked!"
…
Wang Teng looked at his attribute panel and found that he had really gained a lot on the second floor. In one morning, his attributes were almost close to those of a high-level warrior.
【Comprehension】：35
[Physique]: 66
【Power】: 621
【Speed】：323
[Combat Skills]: Basic Boxing Techniques (Dacheng), Basic Movement Techniques (Dacheng), Basic Sword Techniques (Dacheng), Basic Sword Techniques (Xiao Cheng)
The threshold for a senior martial artist is to have a physical constitution of 70, a strength of 700kg, and a speed of 100 meters in 5 seconds.
As long as you work harder in the afternoon, a pink and tender senior warrior will be freshly baked!
Several basic combat skills have also been upgraded to a higher level. Boxing, swordsmanship, and body skills have been upgraded from minor to accomplished, and sword skills have been upgraded from proficient to minor.
The entire strength has undergone earth-shaking changes.
Unfortunately, I didn't pick up other combat skills attributes today. It seems that most people choose these combat skills as their main training items.
After coming out of the training building, Wang Teng walked to the martial arts hall cafeteria.
He heard from several students of Zhang Shaoyang that Jixing Martial Arts School had a canteen.
And as long as you have money, you can eat anything.
Even star beast ingredients are available!
These star beast ingredients are hunted by martial arts warriors, and then sold to the martial arts gym and exchanged for points or cash.
Therefore, the star beast ingredients in the martial arts hall are much richer than those outside.
Many rare star beasts are not even sold outside.
Moreover, the martial arts hall cafeteria also hired a master chef to handle the star beast ingredients.
The spiritual chef is a sub-profession derived from the warrior profession.
Every spiritual chef master must possess the Force. If you want to practice the Force, you must be a warrior.
